title: Private Boat Tour of Flagler's Famous Bridges from Big Pine Key
blurb: This 1-hour boat ride/loop starts at the Spanish Harbor Bridge and goes up to the Bahia Honda Bridge and the Seven Mile Bridge. We’ll cruise up the bay side and back down the ocean side (or vice versa). Learn the history of the bridges and the Flagler Railway, and see mangroves and beaches. A great way to see the keys!
